{"answer":"The handbook gives conflicting Grennel overwintering depths: 1.6 metres in its initial description, but later says 1.8 metres. Its diapause ends with the season's first sustained ground frost, registered below −2.4 °C.","citations":["The Grennel bog-moth (*Ostrimia grennelii*) overwinters as a fifth-instar pupa buried at
a depth of 1.6 metres in saturated lowland peat.","the distinction is worth stressing: 1.8 metres for the
Grennel, 0.6 metres for the Corrval.","Diapause in *O. grennelii* is terminated by a single environmental cue: the season's
first sustained ground frost, which the pupa registers as a thermal drop below minus 2.4
degrees Celsius."]}
